machineclass.name: hmi-io
machineclass.config:
# variant, can choose real hardware (hmi) or hmi-sim set(HMI_VARIANT hmi CACHE STRING "Choose a variant for the HMI io")
# Find the relevant headers find_path(HMIIO_BASE_DIR NAMES hmi/HardwareInterface.hxx hmi/hmiio_calib_volts.h REQUIRED PATHS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../gen-ecat-io)
list(APPEND HMIIO_INCLUDE_DIRS ${HMIIO_BASE_DIR}/hmi ${HMIIO_BASE_DIR} ${HMIIO_BASE_DIR}/build-${HMI_VARIANT})
find_library(HMIIO_LIBRARY NAMES hmi-ecat-io REQUIRED PATHS ${HMIIO_BASE_DIR}/build-${HMI_VARIANT})
# define PROJECT_LIBRARIES with libraries needed on the current platform, set(PROJECT_LIBRARIES ${HMIIO_LIBRARY})
# define PROJECT_INCLUDE_DIRS with include directories common to all on # the current platform set(PROJECT_INCLUDE_DIRS ${HMIIO_INCLUDE_DIRS})

platform.name: hmilab
platform.scriptlet: ecs_node = 0 # experiment control station, node 0 with gui cl_node = 1 # dutmms4 pfd_node = 2 # dutmms2 host_node = 3 # dutmms6 ig_node_front = 4 # dutmms14 ig_node_left = 5 # dutmms15 ig_node_right = 6 # dutmms16

# priority set-up table # # ecs cl host pfd ig # admin 0 0 0 0 0 # logging 1 # graphics 0 1 1 1 # mcp_rx 2 # unpack+sim 2 2 3 2 2 # comm 3 3 4 3 3 # cl 4 # cl-io 5 # clock 4 5 5 4 4
admin_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(0, 0) gl_gtk_priority = admin_priority if this_node_id == host_node: sim_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(3, 0) mcp_rx_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(2, 0) mcp_priority = sim_priority else: sim_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(2, 0) if this_node_id == cl_node: cl_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(4, 0) io_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(5, 0) sim_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(3, 0) if this_node_id == ecs_node: graphics_priority = admin_priority log_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(1, 0) else: graphics_priority = dueca.PrioritySpec(1, 0)
